title: Raid & Grind dungeons
summary: Choose Raid or Grind, track boss credit and claim rewards.
body:
Choose Raid or Grind in 21 Classic dungeons, plus curated level-50 Chapterhouse and Kael expeditions. Hail an entrance Keeper, enroll in a run and earn your own boss-checklist rewards. Runs last up to twelve hours.

Choose a mode

RuleGrindRaid
EnemiesNormal stats and respawns35% more HP, 15% more damage; defeated enemies do not return
BossesRequired bosses available initiallyFinal boss unlocks after all required minibosses
Personal rewardOne Normal itemOne item: 90% Polished, 10% Ascended

Earn your own checklist

The creator chooses the mode. Hail the entrance Keeper for Raid, Grind, Enter, Join, Status, Claim Rewards and Reset. Open Tasks and select your dungeon and mode for its checklist and deadline. Keeper Status lists every required boss, your personal credit and permanent completion counts. A yellow Task Stage Completed message marks one boss objective. A full dungeon clear requires personal credit for every required boss. New High Keep rescue Raids also require surviving the extraction with Osargen; see the rescue instructions. During live testing, if the task objectives are blank or Completed history is missing, use Keeper Status; these display problems do not erase earned credit or rewards. Stay enrolled, connected and within 200 units of your party’s encounter, including vertical distance. Owned-pet kills count for the owner’s party. Missed kills never receive retroactive credit. Grind respawns offer another opportunity; Raid deaths are permanent for that run.

Exclusive Raid rewards

Every Classic dungeon has three exclusive Raid designs. The 14 added dungeons contribute 42 designs in two qualities; all 414 Classic dungeon reward definitions are MAGIC. Fear, Hate and Sky include planar relics and equipped utility clicks.

New recommended levels follow each dungeon’s equipment band. Planar items require level 46. All remain permanent, tradeable, non-LORE, zero-resale and outside existing forging recipes. The original seven exclusive families remain, with MAGIC added where needed. Already earned rewards and generated loot keep their identities.

New numeric power stays within the existing band, slot and quality budgets. Their lore is original Nightcap fiction inspired by each dungeon. Each family has Polished and Ascended versions.

Planar relics

Fear: Visage of Unbroken Will reveals the unseen with See Invisible, beside Spine of the Faceless and Dreadhusk of the Last Stand. Its reuse is five minutes.

Hate: Maestro’s Unfinished Requiem grants Invisibility; Innoruuk’s Severed Covenant and Seal of the First Betrayal recall hatred and broken elven royalty. Its reuse is ten minutes.

Sky: Astrolabe of the Eighth Island grants ordinary Levitate, beside Veeshan’s Unwritten Horizon and Mantle of the First Brood. Its reuse is fifteen minutes. Levitate requires one Bat Wing and respects no-levitation zones, including Sky itself; island keys are still required.

Each click requires equipping the item at level 46 and a ten-second cast. Both qualities and duplicate copies share the same family cooldown; Ascended does not improve the utility. Cast/reuse figures are base values subject to native focus reductions. Native targeting, reagent conservation and spell restrictions remain.

Shared rewards and exclusive drops

Twenty-four shared designs include eight armor pieces, eight weapon families, six accessories and two weight-reduction bags. Every dungeon uses these designs at its equipment band. Original dungeons: Befallen 20; Unrest/Najena 30; High Keep/Cazic-Thule 40; Permafrost/Nagafen’s Lair 50. Selection does not filter by class. Rewards are permanent, tradeable, non-lore and have zero merchant resale. Dungeon rewards cannot be converted by existing forging recipes.

Raid final bosses also drop one, two or three distinct exclusive designs with 80%, 18% and 2% chances. Each independently rolls Polished or Ascended at 90%/10%. Examples include Moltor’s Graveblade, Rucksif’s Mourning Mantle, McCabe’s Hidden Treasury, Vox’s Hoarfrost Satchel and Nagafen’s Emberfang. These shared corpse drops use normal loot controls and are additional to native loot and personal completion rewards.

Weapon delay stays fixed between qualities. Bags have six, eight or ten slots and up to 100% weight reduction. Rewards are selected durably; reconnecting cannot change them. There is one personal completion reward per character per run. A full inventory leaves an earned claim at the Keeper.

Keep progress through interruptions

Progress and the original deadline survive reconnects and restarts. Abandoning the task removes its display, not earned credit. Only the creator can confirm a reset, and no player, pending entry or recoverable player corpse may remain inside. Earned claims survive reset and expiry. Classic Cazic-Thule restoration applies only to managed private instances. Public High Keep, Grind and older Raid runs keep their prior faction behavior; newly enrolled rescue Raids use a temporary run alarm without permanent faction loss.

Testing still required

All 21 Classic dungeons and both curated expeditions need in-game checks in both modes. Cazic-Thule paths and doors, inventory/loot recovery and demanding solo/small-group balance remain open. Lady Vox and Lord Nagafen explicitly require level-50 gameplay acceptance. The equipment index covers the separate zone-hunt catalog; dungeon rewards use the designs and bands described here. Existing forging recipes do not upgrade these rewards.

The Vigil of the Dawn — live testing

Chapterhouse adds a level-50 Raid/Grind expedition with four named enemies and a separate personal Paladin story journal. Chapterhouse contributes six exclusive final Raid variants alongside the shared dungeon completion rewards. Read the quest guide and reward catalog.

Classic dungeon coverage and planar rules

The 21 combat dungeons include Fear, Hate and Sky, with current native populations. Managed Sky has durable key exchangers that still require the normal tokens; its four previously scripted Grind bosses have eight-hour timers and the princess keeps four hours. Public and legacy Sky retain their original behavior. Plane runs isolate quest state from public zones and other runs.

Hate’s public Keeper is in East Commonlands at /loc -1570,-346,3, between Mirielle and Khalure; its private instances keep an entrance Keeper. Hate entry requires level 46.

For the keyless Paineel passage, see Entering The Hole.

The Ashen Compact — live testing

The Ashen Compact is an installed level-50 Shadow Knight helmet campaign in a curated Kael expedition. Its paired server and client release is available for testing; full encounter, rendering and balance acceptance remain open.

Four bosses, personal credit and Raid/Grind journals follow the existing expedition system. The separate story has fourteen objectives and durable progress. Temporary war souls give no loot or XP.

High Keep: rescue Osargen

Live testing. The prison break is installed; escort pathing and full encounter acceptance remain open. It applies only to new Raid runs after this release. Existing runs, Grind and public High Keep keep their current rules.

  1. Bluff your way in. Hail the Gate Sergeant just inside the entrance. Claim to be the relief detail, then insist on seeing Osargen. His suspicion turns into an alarm, and the keep's guards become hostile to everyone in your run. Attacking a guard also raises the alarm.
  2. Break the prison's command. Fight Boshinko on the entrance approach, Bosec at the prison stairs, Dyrna in the prison and McCabe by the cell-block approach. Follow the zone shouts and journal guidance; the route no longer sends you upstairs. Existing boss loot stays.
  3. Bring Osargen out alive. Hail him in his cell and choose Lead the way. He follows your character. Defeat three pairs of pursuers as you return to the entrance; the first pair comes when you release him. He stops while a wave is alive. Intercept or taunt guards and target Osargen directly for heals.
  4. Finish together. Reach the entrance and clear nearby guard combat. Living nearby participants who personally earned all four boss credits receive completion and the existing one-time dungeon reward.

Stay close. If the guide disconnects or falls behind, Osargen waits; another enrolled player can hail him and choose Lead the way. If the current guide dies, another player can take over before the 90-second separation limit. Osargen’s death or 90 seconds without a nearby living guide resets the escort, with another attempt available after 20 seconds. Defeated bosses remain defeated. A zone restart returns an unfinished escort to his cell but preserves the alarm and boss progress. Keeper Claim Rewards remains available for earned rewards when inventory was full. There is no permanent faction penalty or extra reward from repeatedly killing pursuers.

There are now 23 dungeon choices: 21 Classic dungeons, Chapterhouse and curated Kael. Kael adds six exclusive final Raid variants, bringing the combined dungeon item catalog to 426 definitions, including shared completion rewards. Its fourteen total new items include the story helmet, Cinder augment qualities and three named relics.

Zone augment eligibility — Not released

A prepared update expands zone augments to regular combat mobs across public zones and Grind/Raid, including Hate B. It retains0.5% and leaves wearable drop rules unchanged. Read the preview.
